dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It is preserved as a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than misleadingly merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement.

corrections.summary: Added an August 31 statement omitted from earlier review: Vice President JD Vance said he was focused on doing what he considers God's work and accepted either an end-times outcome or a better world that survives long after him. The new record preserves both halves of the answer and states that he did not explicitly connect it to Iran or a specific policy.
